page_title: ATA 2-0 MON | Atalanta v Monza 30/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' The foul by Mattia Valoti (Monza) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Piccinini.
90+3' The foul by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) was seen by Marco Piccinini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+3' Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Mateo Retegui is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta).
88' 2 - 0 Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes in off the post and the score changes to 2:0.
87' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Omari Forson (Monza) coming on for Danilo D'Ambrosio.
86' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
85' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi denies him.
84' Referee Marco Piccinini sees the trip by Marten de Roon (Atalanta) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Monza win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
82' Luca Caldirola (Monza) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
81' Luca Caldirola (Monza) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
78' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) sends a cross in and finds Mateo Retegui inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
78' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
77' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Daniel Maldini (Monza) for a tough tackle.
77' A tremendous drive by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Stefano Turati makes a brilliant save.
75' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
73' Here comes a substitution. Samuele Vignato is given a rest as he is replaced by Gianluca Caprari (Monza).
73' Alessandro Nesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mattia Valoti (Monza) replacing Matteo Pessina.
73' That's the end of the game for Dany Mota, who is replaced by Daniel Maldini (Monza).

70' 1 - 0 Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Mateo Retegui, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
69' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) attempts to find Nicolo Zaniolo, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) is coming onto the pitch as Charles De Ketelaere cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' Half-chance! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) plays a pass into the box, but Stefano Turati reacts well to snuff out the attack.
63' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
58' The Samuele Vignato (Monza) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Marco Piccinini rules it out for a foul.
57' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Raoul Bellanova is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta).
57' Substitution. Matteo Ruggeri did his best and is replaced by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
56' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is the one who receives a yellow card.
54' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
51' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

48' Pedro Pereira (Monza) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Carnesecchi thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
46' Half-time substitution. Ademola Lookman is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
46' Alessandro Nesta makes a half-time substitution. Milan Djuric comes on in place of Mirko Maric (Monza).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Dany Mota (Monza) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

42' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Marco Carnesecchi!
41' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ademola Lookman, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
41' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
40' Matteo Pessina (Monza) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for an infringement. Atalanta will take a free kick.
39' Luca Caldirola (Monza) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
37' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
36' Atalanta are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
32' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Mateo Retegui, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
29' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) commits a foul and Marco Piccinini immediately signals a free kick.
27' Dany Mota (Monza) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' Dany Mota (Monza) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
22' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) gets to a rebound from the corner kick and unleashes a long-range shot. Promising try, but it goes way wide of the left post.
22' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
19' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is able to continue to play.
17' A pass by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' Isak Hien (Atalanta) is penalised for holding. Marco Piccinini signals a set piece.
14' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
13' Dany Mota (Monza) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
11' Atalanta are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
8' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
5' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Stefano Turati.
1' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) passes the ball onto Ademola Lookman, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
